Brazil Unfiltered

Cabra Marcado Para Morrer (Man Marked for Death, 20 Years Later) 

Eduardo Coutinho | 1984 | Brazil | 119’ | EN subtitles 
 


EN Listed by the Brazilian Academy as one of the 5 best Brazilian films of all time, Cabra Marcado Para Morrer (Man Marked for Death, 20 Years Later) is a sort of meta-film, with its production interrupted by twenty years of brutal military dictatorship. The film was originally conceived as a fiction based on the true story of João Pedro Teixeira, a peasant leader executed in 1962 by large landowners in rural Pernambuco. His wife, Elizabeth, was to play herself, alongside other villagers who also acted in the film. During shooting in April 1964, the set was stormed by the military, who arrested many crew members and confiscated most of the materials. Twenty years later, the filmmaker returned to the location to meet the survivors, including Elizabeth, and document what had since happened to them and their families. The documentary stands as a powerful testimony to a dark period in Brazilian contemporary history that should never be repeated.
 

Brazil Unfiltered comes back from 1 to 31 October with a special curation of documentary films to contextualise the presidential elections taking place in Brazil this month. Centred around territorial struggles and the frontlines of resistance, the programme starts with a masterpiece from the late Eduardo Coutinho, followed by a bonus screening, a sequence of 3 films set in the Amazon, and a closure event + screening about climate resilience and ecological farming.

Ménilmontant with live score by Kadavergraver

+ foyer party by Machine Cult Amsterdam 

Dimitri Kirsanoff | 1926 | France | 38’ | silent, no language with live score  



NL Ménilmontant (1926) van Dimitri Kirsanoff is een zelden verteld verhaal over twee zussen; een eigenaardige stille film zonder tussentitels, waarin het verhaal uitsluitend wordt verteld aan de hand van gezichten, gebaren, snelle montages en gefragmenteerde beelden van de vooroorlogse sloppenwijken van Parijs. Tijdens deze vertoning voert de in Amsterdam gevestigde live-elektronica-act Kadavergraver in realtime een nieuw gecomponeerde soundtrack uit. Na afloop wordt de foyer de setting van een feestje geprogrammeerd door Machine Cult Amsterdam, met sets van Déandrah en Garçon Taupe. MEER→


EN Dimitri Kirsanoff’s Ménilmontant (1926) is a rarely told tale of two sisters; a peculiar silent film without intertitles that tells the narrative instead relying solely on faces, gestures, rapid montages and fractured images of Paris’ pre-war slums. For this screening, Amsterdam-based live electronic act Kadavergraver performs a newly created score in real time. Afterwards our foyer becomes the setting for a party programmed by Machine Cult Amsterdam, with sets by Déandrah and Garçon Taupe. Azart – Come Make Art + Q&A

Masha Novikova & Annike Kaljouw | 2023 | NL | 83’ | EN subtitles



NL Deze documentaire vertelt over de kleurrijke en vrolijke geschiedenis van het Amsterdamse narrenschip Azart, ofwel Ship of Fools, dat ruim 30 jaar over de wereld voer om theater, vreugde en dwaasheid te brengen. Met aan het roer de bedenker van dit varend kunstwerk: kapitein en acteur August Dirks, die ruim 30 jaar op de Azart woonde en werkte. Het Amsterdamse Azartplein is genoemd naar deze zottenschuit. Kapitein August wilde de VOC-route varen, zei hij, maar dan wel op een andere manier. “Niet om te stelen en te kelen, maar om te spelen en te delen.” Inmiddels gestrand – letterlijk – op een Zuid-Amerikaans strandje, waar het wonderlijke verhaal nog altijd verder gaat, onder leiding van een lokale theatergroep.

De filmmakers zullen aanwezig zijn en na de vertoning zal er een online Q&A plaatsvinden met August. Het fotoboek AZART De Blauwe Schuit, filmposters en meer zullen deze avond te koop zijn.


EN This documentary tells about the colorful and cheerful history of the Amsterdam Ship of Fools, which sailed around the world for more than 30 years to bring theatre, joy and folly. At the helm is the creator of this sailing work of art: captain and actor August Dirks, who lived and worked on the Azart for more than 30 years. Amsterdam's Azartplein is named after this fool's boat. Captain August wanted to sail the VOC route, he said, but in a different way. “Not to steal and kill, but to play and share.” Now stranded – literally – on a South American beach, where the wonderful story continues, led by a local theater group.

The filmmakers will be in attendance, and there will be an online Q&A with August after the screening. The photo book AZART De Blauwe Schuit, film posters and more will be for sale this evening.

Brazil Unfiltered

Ouvidor

Matias Borgström | 2023 | Brazil | 74’ | EN subtitles



NL Bonusvertoning: vanwege de enorme interesse eerder dit jaar vertonen we Ouvidor opnieuw.

In Ouvidor, het grootste kunstkraakpand van Latijns Amerika, leven 120 kunstenaars uit verschillende landen samen in een levendige micromaatschappij in São Paulo, waar elk van de 13 verdiepingen functioneert als een aparte wijk die gewijd is aan een andere vorm van artistieke expressie. Terwijl ze zich verzetten tegen voortdurende dreigingen van uitzetting door de Braziliaanse regering met fascistische neigingen, worden de interne spanningen aangewakkerd door de sponsoring van hun Art Biennial door Red Bull.


EN Bonus screening: due to the massive attendance in April 2026, we will screen Ouvidor again.

In Ouvidor, the largest art squat in Latin America, 120 artists from various countries coexist in a vibrant micro-society in São Paulo, where each of the 13 floors functions like a distinct neighborhood dedicated to a different form of artistic expression. As they resist constant eviction threats from a government with fascist tendencies in Brazil, internal tensions are fueled by Red Bull’s sponsorship of their Art Biennial.


Brazil Unfiltered comes back from 1 to 31 October with a special curation of documentary films to contextualise the presidential elections taking place in Brazil this month. Un lugar más grande (A Bigger Place) + Q&A 

Nicolas Défossé | 2025 | México | 115' | EN subtitles 



NL Chiapas, Zuidoost-Mexico. Wanneer de bewoners van Tila en omliggende dorpen het gemeentehuis en de politie uit hun gebied verdrijven, staan ze voor de uitdaging om zelfbestuur in de praktijk te brengen. Un lugar más grande (A Bigger Place) verkent de dagelijkse opbouw van autonomie en onthult een breed samenspel van mensen, generaties, geesten en landschappen, evenals nooit eerder getoond beeldmateriaal. De film dompelt ons onder in de kern van een collectief proces, waarin zelfbestuur een verantwoordelijkheid wordt ten opzichte van jezelf en anderen. Een op de zapatisten geïnspireerd avontuur op Ch'ol-Maya-grondgebied.

De regisseur is aanwezig bij de vertoning om met het publiek in gesprek te gaan en vragen te beantwoorden nadat de aftiteling is afgelopen.

 

EN Chiapas, southeastern Mexico. When the people of Tila and neighboring villages run the town hall and police out of their territory, they face the challenge of exercising self-governance. Un lugar más grande (A Bigger Place) explores the day-to-day construction of autonomy, revealing a broad interweaving of people, generations, spirits and landscapes, as well as previously unseen images. It plunges us into the heart of a collective process, where self-governance becomes a responsibility towards oneself and others. A Zapatista-inspired adventure in Ch'ol Mayan territory.

The director will be present at the screening to talk with the audience and answer their questions after the credits finish rolling.

Brazil Unfiltered

Ex-Shaman 

Luiz Bolognesi | 2018 | Brazil | 81’ | EN subtitles  



EN Ex-Shaman is a non-romanticised portrait of the indigenous experience and resilience in contemporary times. Perpera lived in the forest without contact with white people until he was 20 years old. He was a powerful man of the Paiter Suruí people until contact with white men in 1969. Nowadays, illness is a risk for a community increasingly unable to isolate itself from the modernisation brought by white people and the power of the evangelical church.

After being accused by an evangelical pastor of being in league with the Devil, he is forced to become a doorman at the Evangelical church, renouncing his powers as a shaman. However, this mission, commanded by the intolerant pastor, is put to the test when someone from the village witnesses death firsthand, and the indigenous man's sensitivity to the spirits of the forest proves indispensable.

CONTEMPORARY

The Summer with Carmen 

Zacharias Mavroeidis | 2023 | Greece | 106’ | EN subtitles  



EN While enjoying a day at Athens’ queer beach, 30-something Demosthenes offers to help his bestie and aspiring filmmaker Nikitas in drafting an idea for his feature debut, inspired by the events surrounding a certain dog named Carmen. Two summers ago, Demosthenes was stuck in Athens dealing with health issues of his father. This served as an excuse to reach out to his ex, Panos. Meanwhile, Panos got the overly cute Carmen, something he soon regretted. Likewise, Demosthenes seems to have regretted breaking up with Panos. Or did he not? Struggling to transform real events into a hero’s journey, the two friends question the no.1 rule of script writing theory – the hero that changes – while turning a page in their long-lasting friendship.

Brazil Unfiltered

The Territory 

Alex Pritz | 2022 | Brazil, Denmark, USA | 85’ | EN subtitles  


Credit: Alex Pritz/Amazon Land Documentary
 

EN The Territory provides an immersive on-the-ground look at the tireless fight of the Uru-eu-wau-wau people against the encroaching deforestation brought by farmers and illegal settlers in the Brazilian Amazon. With awe-inspiring cinematography showcasing the titular landscape and richly textured sound design, the film takes audiences deep into the Uru-eu-wau-wau community and provides unprecedented access to the farmers and settlers illegally burning and clearing the protected Indigenous land.

Partially shot by the Uru-eu-wau-wau people, the film relies on footage captured over three years as the community risks their lives to set up their own news media team in the hopes of exposing the truth.

Première

Heavy

Max Rothman | 2026 | USA | 110’ | no dialogue 



NL In een idyllisch Amerikaans stadje kijkt de natuur ambivalent toe hoe een naamloze man een moord pleegt. Hij voert de alledaagse handelingen uit die nodig zijn om zijn misdaad te verbergen en verliest bij elke stap het contact met zijn eigen menselijkheid. Verteld in slechts 44 shots zonder dialoog, onderzoekt Heavy de dehumanisering die plaatsvindt wanneer iemand zichzelf verdooft om kwaadaardige daden te rechtvaardigen, en de gebruikelijke rationalisatie die de samenleving in staat stelt een pad van kwaadaardigheid te blijven bewandelen in naam van zelfbehoud. 

Dit is de bioscooppremière van de film, en de regisseur is aanwezig. Mis het niet!

 

EN In a bucolic American town, nature watches ambivalently as an unnamed man commits a murder. He goes through the mundane tasks necessary to cover up his crime, and with each step loses connection with his own humanity. Told in just 44 shots with no on-screen dialogue, Heavy is an examination of the dehumanization that takes place when someone numbs themselves into justifying evil actions, and the habitual rationalization that allows society to continue down a path of malevolence in the name of self-preservation.

This is the theatrical premiere of the film, with the director present! Don’t miss it!

CLASSIC

Time of the Gypsies 

Emir Kusturica | 1988 | Italy, UK, Yugoslavia | 142’ | EN subtitles 



EN Inspired by a newspaper article on child smuggling rings in the 1980s, Kustorica crafted this story with his traditional trace of magical realism and mysticism, to create an extraordinary epic. Follow Perhan, a young Romani teenager with telekinetic powers, as he is seduced by the promised of Ahmed, a wealthy but shady figure who promises to take care of Perhan’s sister’s medical treatment if they join him to Italy. Lured into the elder’s corrupt surroundings, Perhan sets out to lose everything.

Considered to be one of Kustorica’s best films, and earning him the award for best director at the 1989 Cannes Film Festival, the film was filmed between Sarajevo, Skopje and Milan, and features extensive use of the Romani language. The original soundtrack was composed by Goran Bregović, as one of the many instances of collaboration between the two artists.

Brazil Unfiltered

Piripkura

Renata Terra, Mariana Oliva, Bruno Jorge | 2017 | Brazil | 81’ | EN subtitles  



EN Piripkura is the chronicle of an expedition in the Amazonian habitat of the nomadic Piripkura ethnic group’s last remaining members, who can only have their territory protected if there is proof they are still living there. Two of only three of them are known to still live in this area. Every two years, a team of governmental workers trek into the jungle for weeks in search of them. Their most important possession is a torch that was lit in 1998 and has remained so ever since. The area where they live is encircled by farms and sawmills, whose almost inevitable expansion is taking place through violent means.

The film sheds light on the tragedy befalling indigenous Amazon people: the systematic violence used against them is a constant menacing presence. Despite the impressive resilience and tenacity of the last of the Piripkura, an inevitable question hangs in the air: how long can it last?

Winner of the Amsterdam Human Rights Award at IDFA 2017.

SEX POSITIVE

Kissable Screens

Looking Back – by Porn Film Festival Amsterdam

Various | 107’ | EN subtitles  



 

EN This film block was screened at Porn Film Festival Amsterdam, earlier this year.

For a long time, the only places you could watch porn were small, not-too-obvious venues, and usually under the shadow of censorship and the constant threat of closure. Through archival footage and first-hand recollections, we revisit some of these sites: Theatro Gil Vicente in Barcelos, the Mineshaft in Marseille, Bada theatre in Seoul. We also meet Lynnee Breedlove, who spearheaded Homobiles, a queer cab service in San Francisco, and Luz Emilia García, one of the precursors of porn cinema in Colombia. We look back to cherish the oft-forgotten treasures of those who broke ground way before us. 

The screening is a fundraiser for a nascent space for pornography and community in Cali, Colombia.

 

TGX | André Senra Azevedo | 2025 | Portugal | 8’

After the Carnation Revolution, Portugal became a democracy and opened itself to the world. One of its consequences was the spread of erotic and pornographic films. This documentary tells the story of how these films arrived at Theatro Gil Vicente, an emblematic cultural venue of Barcelos.

 

Les fantômes du hard | Lazare Lazarus | 2025 | France | 28’

In August 2022, squatters in Marseille stumble upon a treasure: the archives of the founder of France’s first hardcore BDSM club, the Mineshaft, which opened in 1967. What follows is an investigation to trace history through these archives, piece together a forgotten story, and attempt to build a lineage, a dialogue with his ghost.

The film explores how we might build lines of kinship and continuity with the queer generations that came before us. Central to the film is a meditation on memory, absence, and the intergenerational threads that shape queer existence. The film is made from the archives of the Mineshaft’s founder, preserved at Mémoire des Sexualités, a queer archive center based in Marseille: digitized VHS tapes, intimate photographs, lovers’ letters, objects…

 

Backseat | Rae Threat, Jiz Lee, Robin Astera | 2025 | Germany, UK, US | 6’

A short porn drive through the streets of Berlin navigates trans masculine desire and queer liberation. The video is an homage to Homobiles queer cab service spearheaded by Lynnee Breedlove, the 1980's safer sex PSAs from Gay Men's Health Crisis such as “Car Service” taxi porn, and the dream of a world that is safe to travel freely.

 

Paradise | Minki Hong | 2023 | South Korea | 30’

A fabulous storyteller presents a fascinating tale from yesteryear. A cast of friendly objects joins the storyteller, wandering through the theater while remembering days past when the space used to be filled with gay theater-goers. Their stories revolve around the cruising culture of second-run movie houses in Seoul but also expand to include their memories of gay bars in the Jongro neighborhood, offering a vivid depiction of the early years of South Korean queer culture during the 1970s and 1980s, which until now has been lost to history. 

 

The Night of the Minotaur | Juliana Zuluaga Montoya | 2023 | Colombia | 11’

People wonder where birds go to die. My grandmother’s village had a lighthouse nestled among the mountains, a forest teeming with creatures, and an echo that resonated at night like a warm breeze. That was where the birds went to die. La noche del minotauro is a fantastic tale that draws on archival material to reconstruct the story of Luz Emilia García, a pioneer of Colombian pornographic cinema.

CLASSIC

Les Feuilles Mortes

L'Amour à la Mer

Guy Gilles | 1965 | France | 73’ | EN subtitles  



NL Een jonge Parijse vrouw wordt verliefd op een matroos die ze tijdens haar vakantie ontmoet. De zomer brengt hen samen, de herfst voert hen ieder een andere kant op. Hij keert terug naar Brest, zij naar Parijs. Ze blijven elkaar schrijven terwijl ze ieder hun eigen leven leiden. Liederen, foto’s, flashbacks en collages vloeien door de film en laten heden en verleden, herinnering en geleefde ervaring voortdurend in elkaar overlopen. Terwijl hun relatie langzaam vervaagt, belichamen de geliefden die door de film blijven dwalen zowel een gevoel van verlatenheid als de mogelijkheid van een ander leven.

Het speelfilmdebuut van de eigenzinnige en ten onrechte ondergewaardeerde Guy Gilles, met korte optredens van Alain Delon, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Juliette Gréco en Jean-Claude Brialy.

De overgang van zomer naar herfst is al sinds jaar en dag een poëtisch symbool van verandering. Misschien noemen de Fransen het daarom wel ‘Les Feuilles Mortes’. Een liefde die vervaagt, een verlangen, de angst om te vergeten, een afscheid van wat vertrouwd was. Alles verandert en neemt een andere vorm aan.


EN A young Parisian woman falls in love with a sailor she meets on holiday. Summer brings them together, autumn takes them in different directions. He returns to Brest, she to Paris, hoping for the chance to see him again. They continue writing while living separate lives. Chansons, photographs, flashbacks, and collages drift through the film, allowing past and present, memory and lived experience to constantly overlap. As the relationship begins to fade, the figures left wandering through the film embody both a sense of desolation and the possibility of another life.

The debut feature of the singular and unjustly overlooked Guy Gilles, with brief appearances by Alain Delon, Jean-Pierre Léaud, Juliette Gréco and Jean-Claude Brialy.

The transition from summer to autumn has long been a poetic symbol of change. Perhaps this is why the French call it 'Les Feuilles Mortes'. A love fading, an aspiration, the fear of forgetting, a goodbye to what was familiar. Everything transforms, taking on another form.
